description: Tests for false co-occurrence relationships created solely by proximity in police blotters or multi-case summaries. Robustness category L.

fixtures.input_condition: A single police incident report containing two completely unrelated incidents in different paragraphs

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Incident 1: Ravi Malhotra parked near Andheri. Incident 2: Unrelated party Vikram Rao spotted in separate case.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Simple record-level co-occurrence creates a spurious link between Ravi Malhotra and Vikram Rao despite lack of substantive relationship.
fixtures.rationale: Without sentence-level or dependency-parse relationship extraction, all entities in a record are linked.
fixtures.weakness_description: Co-occurrence linking binds all entities appearing in the same record regardless of whether the text establishes a semantic association. Requires NLP dependency parsing.
